$comment: ST-4701 steam trap twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the trap data sheet, steam tables, the orifice equation and the trap survey history; the gateway sends only what is measured or counted.

twin.name: Steam trap ST-4701 and its trap population

identification.model: TD52M 1/2 in thermodynamic steam trap (screwed, stainless steel)
identification.description: Drip-leg trap on the 10 bar g saturated steam main, one of 800 traps on the site steam distribution system
identification.trap_class: Thermodynamic (EN 26704 / ISO 6704 classification: actuated by fluid dynamics)
identification.monitor: Emerson Rosemount 708 wireless acoustic transmitter (acoustic level and pipe temperature, WirelessHART)
identification.service: Steam main drainage (drip leg), condensate discharged to the condensate return

trap.source: Spirax Sarco TI-P068-18 TD52M, TD52MLC, TD52MA and TD52MLCA thermodynamic steam traps: sizes 3/8, 1/2, 3/4 and 1 in; PMO 42 bar g for saturated steam; TMO 425 C at 42 bar g; minimum operating differential 0.25 bar; back pressure not above 80 % of the upstream pressure; cold hydraulic test 95 bar g.

steam.source: Steam main design pressure 10 bar g (assumption: typical value, replace with your steam main). Steam tables (IAPWS-based): hg at 11 bar abs 2780.65 kJ/kg; feed water from a deaerator at about 105 C, hf at 1.2 bar abs 439.36 kJ/kg (assumption: typical value, replace with your feed water temperature).

leak.source: Failed-open trap modelled as a 1/8 in (3.175 mm) re-entrant orifice discharging to atmosphere with a discharge coefficient of 0.72, as in the US DOE Steam Tip Sheet #1 table (Boiler Efficiency Institute). Napier: W = A x P / 70 lb/s (A sq.in, P psia), i.e. 51.43 x A x P lb/h. The equivalent orifice of a real failed trap is an assumption: typical value, replace with the orifice of your trap model or a measured leak.

acoustic.source: Rosemount 708 acoustic level, 0 to 255 counts. Expected level of a healthy thermodynamic trap = a0 + a1 x differential pressure; level of a trap blowing fully open = open0 + open1 x differential pressure: assumption: typical value, replace with a baseline taken on your own trap when new and on a known failed trap of the same model.

thermal.source: Clamp-on pipe surface temperature of a healthy trap inlet sits a few kelvin below the saturation temperature (insulation and clamp losses): assumption: typical value, replace with the offset measured on your installation.

cycling.source: Cycling rate of a thermodynamic trap on a steam main drip leg at the design condensate load: assumption: typical value, replace with the rate counted on your trap when new. A worn disc makes the trap cycle much faster before it blows through.

economics.source: Steam price 25 per tonne (any currency; the DOE tip sheet example uses $10 per 1000 lb = $22 per tonne), 8000 h per year in service, gas-fired boiler efficiency 85 % on net calorific value, cost of one manual survey visit per trap 12: assumption: typical value, replace with your energy price, operating hours, boiler efficiency and survey contract. Emission factor of natural gas 56.1 kg CO2 per GJ (IPCC 2006 default, net calorific value).

population.source: 800 traps on the site steam distribution system, surveyed as one population. New failures per year: 6 % failed open and 3 % failed cold (assumption: typical value, replace with the rates from your own survey history). Alert when more than 5 % of the population is failed open: the US DOE tip sheet gives less than 5 % for a site with a regular programme and 15 to 30 % after 3 to 5 years without one. Failed-cold alert 3 %: assumption: typical value, replace with your own target.

demo.note: Demo only: the trap cycles in real time; the population counters come from the failure modes, not from the demo clock.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

failed_open.name: Trap failed open (blowing steam)
failed_open.symptoms: acoustic level near the full-open level, inlet at saturation temperature, no cycling

disc_wear.name: Disc and seat wear (rapid cycling, leaking)
disc_wear.symptoms: cycling several times faster than design, acoustic level above expected, inlet at saturation

blocked_cold.name: Trap blocked cold (dirt, strainer, closed valve)
blocked_cold.symptoms: no sound, inlet far below saturation: condensate stands in the drip leg

condensate_overload.name: Condensate load above trap capacity
condensate_overload.symptoms: trap stays open, water noise, inlet subcooled: condensate backing up

backpressure_high.name: High back pressure in the discharge line
backpressure_high.symptoms: discharge pressure above 80 % of the steam pressure, condensate backing up

sensor_fault.name: Acoustic transmitter loose or detached
sensor_fault.symptoms: pipe temperature reads ambient, acoustic level at the floor

survey_lapsed.name: Trap survey lapsed (population)
survey_lapsed.symptoms: days since survey grow; failed-open and failed-cold traps accumulate

population_ageing.name: Population failure rate rising (ageing, poor steam quality)
population_ageing.symptoms: new failed-open traps per year well above the design rate
